decisions.quote: In Bressler et al. (2006), a significantly larger proportion of women selected a humor producer over a humor appreciator for all relationship types. Here, we only replicate this finding for potential long-term partners. When it comes to short-term relationships and friendships, women don't show a clear preference for humor producers versus appreciators.
decisions.reason: While the authors report a similar pattern to Bressler et al. (2006) on the Categorization Questionnaire, they explicitly state that on the Preferences Questionnaire across relationship types they only replicated the original finding for long-term partners and not for short-term relationships or friendships.
